source._build_packages_note: Derived from upstream's own builder (dockerfiles/Dockerfile:39-58) minus what this build turns off: libpq-dev/postgresql-server-dev-all (out_pgsql stays Off - its default in cmake/plugins_options.cmake:143) and libcurl4-openssl-dev (nothing links curl: cmake/kafka.cmake:77 sets librdkafka WITH_CURL Off). cmake: Ubuntu 24.04 ships 3.28.3; the highest cmake_minimum_required anywhere in the tree is 3.21, and upstream pins cmake < 4.0 (dockerfiles/Dockerfile:57), which 3.28 satisfies. flex+bison are needed for the record accessor and stream processor parsers (CMakeLists.txt:485-490). libsasl2-dev turns on librdkafka SASL (cmake/kafka.cmake:10-20); without it Kafka SASL/OAUTHBEARER/MSK-IAM are silently compiled out.
source_prep: sed -i '/^message(STATUS "Git hash: /i set(FLB_GIT_HASH "@COMMIT@")' CMakeLists.txt && grep -qF 'set(FLB_GIT_HASH "@COMMIT@")' CMakeLists.txt
source._source_prep_note: CMakeLists.txt:474-481 fills FLB_GIT_HASH from `git log -1` with ERROR_QUIET, and the vendor stage deletes .git, so without this the binary prints an empty 'Git commit:' line (include/fluent-bit/flb_version.h.in:52). The sed stamps the tag's commit (@COMMIT@, from source.commit) right before the message() line, overriding the empty execute_process result. Deterministic; the grep fails the vendor stage if upstream ever rewords that line. Checked 2026-10-04 by running the rendered command with /bin/sh in a v5.1.3 checkout: it inserted set(FLB_GIT_HASH "d1be1ba3...") directly above the message() line.
build_cmds: install -d /fluent-bit/bin /fluent-bit/etc && install -m 0755 build/bin/fluent-bit /fluent-bit/bin/fluent-bit && install -m 0644 conf/parsers.conf conf/parsers_ambassador.conf conf/parsers_java.conf conf/parsers_extra.conf conf/parsers_openstack.conf conf/parsers_cinder.conf /fluent-bit/etc/
/fluent-bit/bin/fluent-bit --version > /tmp/flb.version && cat /tmp/flb.version && grep -qF 'Fluent Bit v@VERSION_BARE@' /tmp/flb.version && grep -qF 'Git commit: @COMMIT@' /tmp/flb.version
source._build_cmds_note: Flags mirror upstream's release container build (dockerfiles/Dockerfile:79-96: FLB_SIMD, FLB_RELEASE, FLB_JEMALLOC, FLB_TLS, FLB_SHARED_LIB=Off, FLB_EXAMPLES=Off, FLB_HTTP_SERVER, FLB_IN_EXEC=Off, FLB_IN_SYSTEMD, FLB_OUT_KAFKA, FLB_LOG_NO_CONTROL_CHARS) with these SURFACE REDUCTIONS: FLB_WASM/FLB_IN_EXEC_WASI/FLB_FILTER_WASM/FLB_WAMRC Off (removes the bundled WAMR 2.4.1 runtime, whose optional cmake modules carry FetchContent git clones - lib/wasm-micro-runtime-WAMR-2.4.1/core/iwasm/**/*.cmake - so dropping it also removes the only network-capable code in the configure step); FLB_PROXY_GO Off (no dlopen of Go .so output plugins); Calyptia connectors Off; FLB_CHUNK_TRACE Off (removes the /api/v1/trace endpoints - upstream ships it On, Dockerfile:28); FLB_OUT_PGSQL Off (upstream's image turns it On; keeping it Off keeps libpq5 + its Kerberos/LDAP closure out of the runtime). FLB_ZIG is auto-off anyway (needs zig 0.14.0 on PATH, CMakeLists.txt:492-509). FLB_RELEASE selects RelWithDebInfo (-O2 -g), GCC LTO (FLB_IPO=ReleaseOnly, CMakeLists.txt:558-567) and the hardening flags relro/now/noexecstack/stack-protector/_FORTIFY_SOURCE=1 (CMakeLists.txt:575-587). The binary is left unstripped as upstream ships it: libbacktrace uses the debug info for crash stack traces. The final step fails the build unless the binary reports this exact version AND commit.
source._install_note: Not `make install`: src/CMakeLists.txt:621-700 also installs systemd/upstart units to absolute paths outside any prefix. The /fluent-bit/{bin,etc} layout copies upstream's image (Dockerfile:36, 100-110) so upstream docs that mount /fluent-bit/etc/fluent-bit.conf work unchanged.
source._vendored_deps_note: Bundled in-tree under lib/ at v5.2.0 and statically linked: librdkafka 2.15.0, LuaJIT (rolling 2.1 at commit c6ffc141), c-ares 1.34.6, nghttp2 1.65.0, SQLite 3.54.1 (lib/sqlite, the split sources tools/update-sqlite.py prepared from sqlite-src-3540100.zip; nothing is downloaded at configure or build time, cmake/sqlite.cmake), zstd 1.5.7, jemalloc 5.3.0 (upstream tried 5.4.0 in this cycle and restored 5.3.0 before the release), Onigmo 6.2.0 (with fluent's match-operation limit, DEFAULT_MATCH_OPERATION_LIMIT=10000000, CMakeLists.txt), msgpack-c 3.3.0, simdutf 5.5.0, yyjson 0.13.0, miniz, mpack 1.1.1, libbacktrace (b9e4006), monkey, cmetrics 2.3.1, ctraces 0.8.0, cfl 1.1.0, chunkio 1.5.5 and cprofiles (Fluent org libs). v5.1.5 bundled LuaJIT 7152e154, SQLite 3.51.1 and yyjson 0.12.0. OpenSSL, libyaml, Cyrus SASL, libsystemd and zlib come from Ubuntu 24.04 (dynamic). Statically linked libraries carry no package metadata, so Docker Scout cannot see them: they are part of the CVE floor that must be checked by hand, not by the Scout grade.
